instruction: Utilize the web-based extension generator to build a new project called "page-marker v3.0.0". Set description to blank. Include only browser action - no background script, content scripts, or options page. Save to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: This variation creates a minimal page-marker extension with version 3.0.0, only browser action enabled. The evaluator checks the manifest.json for correct name, version, and presence of browser_action key only. Uses existing check_json metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Missing verification of 'description to blank' requirement - instruction explicitly requires description to be blank, but evaluator does not check this
Missing exclusion checks for unwanted components - instruction says 'no background script, content scripts, or options page' but evaluator does not verify these are absent
Only verifies 3 out of 5 instruction requirements (name, version, browser_action exist) but misses description and exclusions
Partial coverage: evaluator will pass even if description is non-blank or if background/content_scripts/options_page are present
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add expect rule to verify description is blank: either check description key doesn't exist OR check it equals empty string/null
Add unexpect rules to verify exclusions: check that 'background', 'background_script', 'content_scripts', 'options_page', and 'options_ui' keys do not exist
Consider adding the following to 'expect' rules: {"key": ["description"], "method": "eq", "ref": ""} or similar blank check
Consider adding 'unexpect' section with rules for: ['background'], ['background_script'], ['content_scripts'], ['options_page'], ['options_ui']

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
